title: Share {name}
intro: A read-only link anyone can open without an account: the sheet, and what you include below.

mode.pinned: This version as it is now ({label})

modeHint.pinned: Keeps showing this run, even after you generate again.
modeHint.latest_issued: Moves to each version you save; shows nothing until one is saved.

label: Label (for your list)
anyone: Anyone with the link can open it, so send it only to people who should see this BoQ. You can revoke it at any time.
createdHint: Copy the link now: for safety it is shown only once.
views: {count, plural, =0 {not opened yet} one {opened once, {when}} other {opened # times, last {when}}}
revokeBody: The link stops working at once. Whoever has it sees that it is no longer available.
orgIntro: Every public link of the organisation's BoQs. Revoking one stops it at once; switching public links off in General stops them all.

public.workingHint: This is a working version: it can still change.
public.nothingSaved: Nothing has been saved yet. This link shows the latest saved version once there is one.
public.gone: This link is no longer available
public.goneHint: It was revoked, it expired, or it never existed. Ask whoever sent it for a new one.
public.readOnly: Read-only. Quantities are taken from the models only: work not modelled as objects is included only where derived or added by hand.
